name: @activegraph/pack-diligence
description: The Diligence reference pack: 8 object types, 7 behaviors, 3 tools, recorded fixtures.

scripts.build: tsc -b && node -e "import('node:fs/promises').then(async fs => { await fs.mkdir('dist/prompts', { recursive: true }); const files = await fs.readdir('src/prompts'); for (const f of files) if (f.endsWith('.md')) await fs.copyFile('src/prompts/' + f, 'dist/prompts/' + f); })"
